text:
(2) The relevant bodies aforesaid are—
(a) where the respondent is a doctor, the General Medical Council, the
Royal Colleges of Physicians of London and Edinburgh, the Royal
Colleges of Surgeons of England and Edinburgh, the Royal College of
Physicians and Surgeons (Glasgow), the Royal College of Obstetricians
and Gynaecologists, the Royal College of General Practitioners, the Royal
Medico-Psychological Association and the British Medical Association;
(b) where the respondent is a dentist, the General Dental Council and the British
Dental Association;
(c) where the respondent is a veterinary practitioner or veterinary surgeon,
the Royal College of Veterinary Surgeons and the British Veterinary
Association.
[F271(2A) The chairman of a tribunal shall vacate his office on the day on which he attains the
age of [F27275].]
